caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a person reclining on a structure that resembles a small couch or brick bench. The figure is dressed in a long, dark robe with folds and shadows rendered in tones of black, deep green, and brown. The person's head is bald on top with dark hair on the sides, and the face has a smiling expression, colored in light brown and pinkish hues with detailed features. The figure's left arm is bent at the elbow and raised, with an open hand showing the palm, while the right arm is extended upward, holding what appears to be two green rectangular objects, likely paper or letters. The legs are crossed at the ankles, with the feet pointing outward, and the shoes are dark in color. The structure the figure is lying on is colored in brown and brick red with a texture suggestive of masonry, and a yellow cushion or fabric is positioned behind the figure's back. The background is plain and light, and the lower right corner contains the text "EDWARD BUECHNER."
title: Trick Bank
